caption: The drawing consists of four main elements, all rendered in a palette of muted gold, reddish-brown, teal blue, and a pale background that resembles aged paper. At the top, there is a stylized cross outlined in reddish-brown and filled with gold, with teal and gold decorations inside and radiating gold lines around its center. Directly below the cross is a bow-like shape with four symmetrical elongated loops outlined in teal blue, filled with gold, and speckled with red dots, joined at the center with a circular blue and gold element that has a red star inside. Flanking this central bow motif are two gold wing-like shapes positioned horizontally, each with three reddish-brown tips at their lower edges. At the bottom of the composition is a large circular medallion outlined in reddish-brown, containing a complex radial mandala design in blue, gold, and red. The entire arrangement appears centered and is set against a textured beige background.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
